data_policy: Curated factual fields only. Every device record includes its source. OpenWrt Table of Hardware is linked as a live external catalogue; its full dataset is not copied into this app.

verified_specs.wifi: 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz; official product guide describes 802.11ac/b/g/n

caveats: ISP-customized firmware and enabled features can vary by operator and software release.
Do not flash generic firmware or alter GPON serial, LOID, VLAN, WAN authentication, or OMCI settings.
The Nokia product guide is proprietary; this app stores a short factual summary and links to the source, not the document contents.

catalogues.name: OpenWrt Table of Hardware
catalogues.coverage_note: Thousands of devices, hardware capabilities and OpenWrt support status. Not a universal list of ISP-locked GPON ONTs.
catalogues.license_note: OpenWrt wiki hardware data is generally CC BY-SA 4.0; confirm current upstream terms and preserve attribution/share-alike obligations before redistributing extracted data.

catalogues.name: OpenWrt hardware data repository
catalogues.license_note: Repository code is GPL-2.0. Do not assume the code license automatically covers all underlying wiki data.

catalogues.name: OpenDeviceDB
catalogues.coverage_note: Directory aggregating open-firmware and open-protocol device projects; useful for discovering project support, not a general router repair database.
